summary: Janus Living, Inc., a Maryland REIT listed on the NYSE under JAN, filed a Form 8-K reporting an amended and restated credit agreement dated September 17, 2026, with Bank of America as administrative agent. The revolver was expanded from $500 million to $1.25 billion, with an accordion permitting up to $1.75 billion in aggregate revolving and incremental term loans. The prior $100 million delayed draw term loan facility was terminated. No equity, stake, price per share, premium, or change-of-control terms were disclosed; this is a routine financing event.
